stylingNotes: Orange (#e64626, ochre) panel on the left with italic serif H1 "About us" and a 22px subheading; lab photo on the right, offset above and below the band (m-hero--style-3 / featured bleed-image). No CTA.

Orange (#e64626) panel left with italic serif H1 "Neurological and CNS Disorders", subheading and a dark "Our research" button; spinal-cord neuron micrograph right, offset above/below the band (m-hero--style-3).

Orange (#e64626) panel left with italic serif H1 'News and events', subheading and two buttons (dark filled 'Partner with us', outlined 'Get involved'); lab photo right, offset above/below the band (m-hero--style-3).

Orange (#e64626, ochre) panel left with italic serif H1 "Partnerships", subheading and two buttons (dark filled "Contact us", outlined "Become a member"); lab photo right, offset below the band (m-hero--style-3 featured bleed-image).

Orange (#e64626) panel on the left with serif italic white H1 "Researcher development", subheading "Fostering academic excellence" and dark "Become a member" button; photo (ddi-i-have-a-phd.jpeg) on the right, extending below the orange panel.
Orange (#e64626) panel left with italic serif H1 "What is drug discovery?" and subheading; photo of glass vials on a conveyor right, extending below the band (m-hero--style-3). No CTA.
variantRationale: Orange panel beside an offset photo (side-by-side), unlike hero-orange-band which stacks a full-bleed image above the band and has a CTA; about 60% similar
Orange panel with H1 + subheading + button beside offset photo; matches the planned variant from about-us/partnerships
Orange panel with H1 + subheading + two buttons beside an offset photo; matches the planned variant (hero-orange-band stacks the image above the band, so it is not a match)
Planned from about-us: orange panel with H1 + subheading beside an offset photo; this page adds two CTA buttons (same layout, >=80% match)
Orange panel with H1 + subheading + button beside a photo - exact match for the planned hero-orange-split; hero-orange-band (photo above a full-width band) is a different layout
Planned on about-us/partnerships: orange panel with H1 + subheading beside an offset photo; same layout here without buttons (>=80%). hero-orange-band stacks a full-bleed image above the band (~60%).
visualCharacteristics.purpose: Orange band with H1, subheading and optional CTAs left; photo right overhanging the band bottom

contentPattern.summary: Page hero: title beside a full-bleed image on a coloured band; the background colour belongs to the block
contentPattern.structure: row 1 = image; row 2 = H1 title, subheading paragraph, optional CTA links (one per paragraph; first = filled, others = outlined)

blockContent.notes: Single column; image row then text row (as hero-orange-band). No CTA on this page.
